verdict.rationale: Twenty's docs say you can connect a Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 mailbox. Once connected, emails are automatically linked to the matching Company and People records, with filters by date range or sender to control what is imported. However, the evidence only describes importing mail into the CRM; nothing shows two-way sync, such as sending or replying from Twenty and having it reflected in the mailbox. Missing for 10: evidence of two-way sync, confirmation that consumer Gmail/Outlook accounts work (not just Workspace/365), and independent or hands-on corroboration of matching accuracy.
